editorial.blurb: This vibrant Thai street food spot near the Blue Line delivers bold, authentic flavors with a playful modern touch—from perfectly spiced khao soi to creative fusion appetizers.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the khao soi chicken (even the mild version packs heat) and grab the $3 lunch appetizers before noon—crispy noodles and bone-in chicken that falls off the bone are worth the visit alone.
